desc:
Train & fight others to be the strongest.

📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)
⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates

🖥️ Controls
G - ultimate mode
F - block
Q - dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - run
Left Click - punch
B - emote wheel

This game includes randomized rewards (emotes). All items have an equal chance of being obtained. No duplicates are possible.

Play as your favorite characters!:
KJ, JK, V, Gojo, Sans, Verity and more!

Contributions: @kobikade & @Raxfael20007 & @Examination & @hotsoupiee
